identities.name: DA-01 J - diag(x) DF == diag(F_1,F_2,F_3) (vanishes at F=0)
identities.assumptions: identity holds for all (x,y,z); at an equilibrium F=0 so J = diag(x*) DF

identities.name: DA-01 beta/kappa/L3 invariant under left positive diagonal scaling (generic 3x3)
DA-01 orbit equivalence {D J(x*)} = {E B}
identities.argument: D -> D diag(x*) is a bijection of the positive diagonal cone (inverse D -> D diag(x*)^-1); hence the spectra sets coincide and F_alpha / D_H membership of J and B are equivalent.

identities.name: DA-02 kappa = beta12 + beta13 + beta23 - 2 - L3
DA-02 T1 - kappa = 2 + L3 + 2(sqrt(b12 b13)+sqrt(b12 b23)+sqrt(b13 b23))
identities.assumptions: beta_ij > 0 (needs only the order-two minors positive), L3 >= 0

identities.name: DA-02 no-go minimal hypotheses
identities.argument: T1 - kappa = 2 + L3 + 2 sum sqrt(beta_i beta_j) > 0 for every beta > 0 and L3 >= 0; L3 >= 0 holds for all positive parameters including c12 = 0 or c21 = 0 (then L3 may be 0), and beta23 -> 0+ is harmless (T1 - kappa >= 2). Strict-P is only needed to invoke Cain's (alpha=1) classification; kappa < T1 itself holds on the whole positive-beta set.

identities.name: DA-03 kappa = sum beta - 2 + h q1 q2 (e1 e3 - e2)/(s c1 c2)
DA-03 L3 = h q1 q2 (e2 - e1 e3)/(s c1 c2)  (C-13 convention)
DA-03 oriented cycles: a12 a23 a31 = +e2 q1 q2 h, a13 a32 a21 = -e1 e3 q1 q2 h
DA-04 strict-P analysis
identities.argument: p_i = (s, c1, c2) > 0 iff s > 0; m12, m13, m23 are sums of positive terms once s > 0; q = s(c1c2+e3h^2) + c1 e2 q2^2 + c2 e1 q1^2 + h q1 q2 (e1 e3 - e2). If e1 e3 >= e2 every term is positive, so e1 e3 > e2 is SUFFICIENT, NOT NECESSARY: the exact strict-P condition is s > 0 and q > 0, i.e. h q1 q2 (e2 - e1 e3) < s(c1c2+e3h^2) + c1 e2 q2^2 + c2 e1 q1^2. A transparent sufficient condition weaker than e1e3>e2 follows from AM-GM: c1 e2 q2^2 + c2 e1 q1^2 >= 2 q1 q2 sqrt(c1 c2 e1 e2), hence q > 0 whenever h (e2 - e1 e3) <= 2 sqrt(c1 c2 e1 e2).

identities.name: DA-04 AM-GM residual c1 e2 q2^2 + c2 e1 q1^2 - 2 q1 q2 sqrt(c1 c2 e1 e2) = (sqrt(c1 e2) q2 - sqrt(c2 e1) q1)^2
DA-05 Z(X) = [e3 h A1 + c1 A2]/Delta
DA-05 q1 Y + q2 Z = chi X - nu
DA-05 quadratic: K(X+a)[g_DA(X) - (chi X - nu)] == -(claimed quadratic)
identities.assumptions: multiplication by K(X+a) > 0 for X > 0 introduces no root: the polynomial at X=-a equals r(1+a/K)(-a-m) != 0

identities.name: DA-05 polynomial at X=-a equals -r(K+a)(a+m) != 0 (no spurious root from the multiplication)
DA-06 determinant residual h q1 q2 (e1 e3 - e2)/(s c1 c2) = R
identities.residual_raw: sqrt(A)*sqrt(B0)*sqrt(C)*sqrt(4 + R**2/(A*B0*C))/2 - sqrt(A)*sqrt(B0)*sqrt(C)*sqrt(4 + R**2/(A*B0*C))/(2 + R**2/(A*B0*C) + R*sqrt(4 + R**2/(A*B0*C))/(sqrt(A)*sqrt(B0)*sqrt(C))) - R/2 - R/(2 + R**2/(A*B0*C) + R*sqrt(4 + R**2/(A*B0*C))/(sqrt(A)*sqrt(B0)*sqrt(C)))

identities.name: DA-06 positivity / efficiencies
identities.argument: tau > 1 for rho > 0 (tau = (rho + sqrt(rho^2+4))/2 > (0+2)/2 = 1); e1=e3=eta in (0,1), e2 = eta^2/tau^2 in (0, eta^2) subset (0,1); q1,q2,h are square roots of positive numbers; q = kappa s c1 c2 > 0 automatically since kappa > sum beta - 2 > 1 > 0. As R -> 0+: rho -> 0, tau -> 1, e2 -> eta^2: no blow-up. The image of the construction is exactly {beta_ij > 1, kappa > sum beta - 2}, an open 4-dimensional set; the IGP architecture cannot realize beta23 <= 1 (beta23 = 1 + e3 h^2/(c1 c2) > 1) nor beta12, beta13 <= 1.

identities.name: DA-06 Jacobian rank of (beta12,beta13,beta23,kappa) w.r.t. (q1,q2,h,e2) at a rational point
DA-07 g_DA(X) = Q with r = Q(X+a)/[(1-X/K)(X-m)]
DA-07 all three equilibrium equations vanish
DA-07 r -> s X (X+a)/(X-m) as K -> X+ (finite, positive)
DA-07 quantified feasibility
identities.argument: H_A > 0 iff K - X < (X-m)(X+a)/(m+a) (from 1/(K-X) > (m+a)/((X-m)(X+a))); Q = s/H_A is continuous and decreasing to 0 as K -> X+; mu1 > 0 iff Q < e1 q1 X / (xi c1/q1 + (1-xi) h/q2); mu2 > 0 iff Q (1-xi) c2/q2 < e2 q2 X + e3 h xi Q/q1, i.e. always if (1-xi)c2/q2 <= e3 h xi/q1, else Q < e2 q2 X / ((1-xi)c2/q2 - e3 h xi/q1). Hence an explicit interval X < K < K_max(s, X, m, a, ...) makes every parameter positive; r stays bounded (limit s X (X+a)/(X-m)); nothing blows up.

identities.name: DA-09 dX/dm = -Q/[(X-m)(s+chi)]
identities.residual_raw: Q/(chi*m - chi*X(m) + m*s - s*X(m)) + Q/(-chi*m + chi*X(m) - m*s + s*X(m))

identities.name: DA-09 ds/dm sign
identities.expression: ds/dm = chi X' H_A + Q[(dH_A/dX) X' - 1/(X-m)^2]
identities.argument: With Q > 0 (positive predation at coexistence), s = Q H_A > 0 => H_A > 0; chi > 0 (true when e1 e3 >= e2; more generally chi Delta = e1 c2 q1^2 + e2 c1 q2^2 + h q1 q2(e1e3-e2)); then s + chi > 0 => X' = dX/dm < 0; dH_A/dX > 0 (m > -a, automatic for m > 0); so every term is negative: chi X' H_A < 0, Q dH_A/dX X' < 0, -Q/(X-m)^2 < 0. Minimal assumptions: Q>0, s>0, chi>0, X>m>-a. If chi <= 0 the sign of X' and of the first term is not controlled: e1e3>e2 (or chi>0) is genuinely used.

identities.name: DA-10 path invariants: beta12=1+A0 t etc. from B with t=1/s
DA-10 G1(t) = kappa(t) - T1(beta(t)) closed form
DA-10 G1''(t) = (A0-B0)^2/(2 p^{3/2}) + sqrt(C0)[A0^2/(2(1+A0t)^{3/2}) + B0^2/(2(1+B0t)^{3/2})] > 0
identities.assumptions: manifestly positive: strict convexity for every A0,B0,C0,E0 > 0

identities.name: DA-10 lim G1(t)/t = E0 - 2 sqrt(A0 B0)
DA-10 root existence/uniqueness/transversality
identities.argument: G1 strictly convex, G1(0) < 0. If E0 > 2 sqrt(A0 B0): G1 -> +oo, so exactly one root t_H > 0. Transversality is automatic: convexity gives G1'(t_H) >= (G1(t_H) - G1(0))/t_H = (4 + 4 sqrt(C0))/t_H > 0, so G1'(t_H) cannot vanish. If E0 <= 2 sqrt(A0 B0): G1 < 0 for all t (G1 ~ (E0-2sqrt(A0B0)) t - 2 sqrt(C0)(sqrt A0 + sqrt B0) sqrt t -> -oo or stays negative by convexity), so no crossing: the condition E0 > 2 sqrt(A0 B0) is necessary and sufficient for a crossing.

identities.name: DA-11 G1(t0) = 0 with the prescribed E0
DA-11 E0 - 2 sqrt(A0 B0) = [2 + 2(sqrt(p(t0)) - sqrt(A0 B0) t0) + 2 sqrt(C0)(...)]/t0 with sqrt(p) > sqrt(A0B0) t0
identities.assumptions: p(t0) = 1 + (A0+B0) t0 + A0 B0 t0^2 > A0 B0 t0^2, so every bracketed term is positive: E0 > 2 sqrt(A0 B0)

identities.name: DA-12 C-07 classification of B2
identities.argument: C-07: B2 in F_alpha^(2) iff det > 0 (= pq, true), a11 = g'(X) <= 0, a22 = 0 <= 0. Classical 2x2 D-stability iff det > 0, a11,a22 <= 0 and a11 + a22 < 0, i.e. g'(X) < 0. Difference set: g'(X) = 0 (then B2 = [[0,-q],[p,0]] has eigenvalues +-i sqrt(pq), |arg| = pi/2 > alpha pi/2). Admissibility of m_c: m_c < X iff (K-X)(X+a) > 0 (true); m_c > 0 iff X^2 + 2aX > Ka.
identities.assumptions: p, q, d > 0, X = d/p in (m, K)
